justification: The brand is pivoting out of Cooper Kupp's name and into Ladd McConkey's momentum — Kupp's a legend, but 6.0 projected points isn't a moment, it's a rerun, and this house doesn't air reruns two weeks running after the Eagles-defense debacle got printed as a crime scene. McConkey's healthy, he's trending, and he slides into the FLEX where Kupp sat. Stroud, Jefferson, and McMillan are locked in as the headline talent, Allgeier keeps his seat after last week's 33.6-point mic-drop, and yes — Saquon Barkley starts at RB2 Questionable tag and all, because a 63-yard touchdown run is exactly the kind of content you don't bench on a maybe. Kittle, Smack, and the Eagles D round out a lineup that's not perfect, it's a LAUNCH — and this week it's aimed squarely at Maura.
forum_post: Soft rebrand, hard results: Kupp's out of the FLEX, McConkey's in, and the growth-week era is OVER — this is the glow-up era now. Maura, love, I adore you, I really do, but JSN and Golden putting up twenty a man doesn't scare a team that just watched Tyler Allgeier go for 33 and change. Kris, you want a cover story? Here it is: two straight weeks of "disaster" and this week I built the lineup with my own two hands and no bye weeks hiding in it. Can't wait for you guys to see this. 💫
